# Parley v0.1.65

This unnotarized test beta lets agents and you put images in handoffs. It
says when a delivered handoff never started a turn, and lets you send a
delegation again when it never arrived. Throughout the app, it says why
something is unavailable instead of leaving a dead control. It also gives
Compare the whole window and checks a pack's files are current before
sending.

## Restart for protocol 34

The agent protocol moves from version 33 to 34. After the update every
running agent pane shows **RESTART FOR PROTOCOL**. Restarting ends that
pane's current conversation unless the vendor's own Resume brings it back.
The new protocol text covers:
- staging and returning PNG or JPEG images, and fetching them with
  `parley image <sha256> --to <file>`;
- `targetTurnStarted` for each delegation in `parley status`, with the
  instruction to ask the person, never to resend.

## Images in handoffs

- **From agents:** an agent can stage a PNG or JPEG of at most 10 MB, with
  `parley context draft` or `context add --file`, or return one with
  `parley done <id> --file`. A Codex pane using its own computer use can
  hand over a screenshot this way. Parley shows each image as a preview
  before anything is sent.
- **From you:**
  - **Capture Window…** in your own context pack opens the macOS window
    picker and captures the one window you pick, once.
  - **Add Files** now takes PNG and JPEG images as well as text files.
  - **Inspect Full Size…** under any preview opens the image with zoom, so
    you can read fine text before sending. A very large image is shown
    scaled down, and says so.
  - You can also add a capture or an image to an agent's draft while it
    waits for your review.
  - Images go with Compare and with an Ask held in the busy queue.
- **Who sees an image:** the agent that staged it, and the pane you send a
  pack holding it to. An image you add stays yours: the agent whose draft
  you added it to cannot fetch it. Naming an image's digest in a message
  grants nothing. Status Center shows the images sent with an Ask under
  **SENT IMAGES**.
- **Storage:** Parley keeps one checked copy of each image, at most 500 MB
  in all, and deletes it once no saved review, open pack or retained
  handoff holds it. **Delete Saved Context** frees space at once.

## When a handoff never arrives

- A minute or more after an Ask or Delegate is delivered, Status Center says
  **No turn-start report since delivery** if the target has not reported
  starting a turn. That comes from the vendor's own turn-start hook, never
  from terminal text, so it is advisory: Claude and Codex report it, Copilot
  when its plugin hook runs, Agy never. It names what to do next.
- **Delegate This Again…** sends an ended delegation again on its original
  route, as Ask This Again does for an Ask. For one that never arrived, look
  at the target pane, use **Cancel Tracking**, then Delegate This Again. The
  preview warns that a target that did receive it would get it twice, a busy
  target is refused, and both delegations show **SENT AGAIN** with a link
  to the other.

## Saying why

- The **Ask** and **Review** menus stay open when nothing can be asked, and
  say why: no agent pane selected, the pane is not running or needs a
  restart, or no other agent pane is ready. A second pane of the same
  vendor is a valid target, which the old message denied.
- A context pack's **Ask One Pane** and **Compare Panes** say what holds
  them back, such as a missing request or too few ready panes.
- **Move to Workspace** marks a destination that already has the pane's
  role or a Workspace Lead, instead of refusing after you choose it.
- A delegation that returned a file shows the file's state (FILE AWAITING
  REVIEW, REVIEWED PACK SENT and so on) beside its own, with **Review
  Returned File…** among its actions.
- A stale pane is called RESTART FOR PROTOCOL everywhere, and the dock's
  Protocol line counts the panes that need it.

## Easier to start

- Help opens on **Start here**, which now walks through a first Ask step by
  step. The first-run check offers **Show Me How**.
- The Pane menu gains **Split Below** and **In Another Folder**; its items
  used to split beside only.
- In an empty workspace, Return opens **New Agent…**.
- Settings and the launch review can be resized for larger text or a small
  display.

## Compare and context

- **Compare** answers share the window as columns, scrolling sideways only
  when there are too many to fit. **One at a Time** shows one answer across
  the whole window. A long question can be shown in full.
- Just before a pack is sent, Parley reads its text files again. If one
  changed on disk, went, or no longer reads as text, it says which and asks:
  **Send Captured Version** sends what you added, and **Capture Again**
  (your own pack) replaces the files you had not edited so you can review
  them first.
- An **Agy** launch review reads Agy's own settings, without changing them.
  It says whether the allow entry for Parley's command is there, and offers
  **Copy Allow Entry**. Agy's rules beyond that entry are not evaluated, and
  the review says so.

## Other fixes

- **Dictate** is click to start, click to stop; Control-Shift-Space is
  still held.
- A `parley wait` could end with "a ticket is required for this pane" while
  the Mac slept and woke briefly every few seconds. The command now sends
  the request again when the ticket socket did not answer.
- A pane whose own `processing` or `outbox` folder disappeared waited
  forever on every `parley` command. The folder is now made again, and a
  link put in its place is refused rather than followed.
- The command palette no longer loses the arrow-key selection to a pointer
  resting over the list.
- The returned-file warning and the recovery steps in Status Center are
  larger.

## Going back to v0.1.64

v0.1.64 cannot read a saved review that holds a window capture: after you
add a capture to an agent's draft, v0.1.64 stops loading saved context until
that review is deleted. Delete it here first if you plan to go back. Older
versions read other image parts as their text description and drop the image
on their next save.

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the following before publishing this beta:
- the deterministic checks and the repository scans;
- the app build and the 25-round Ghostty soak;
- packaging, checksums and packaged-launch verification.

Checked in code and automated checks, but not yet by hand in the app:
- the window picker, including whether macOS asks for Screen Recording
  permission;
- Add Files with images, Inspect Full Size, and images through Compare and
  the busy queue;
- Delegate This Again and the turn-start advisory;
- the menus' explanations, Compare's layouts, the file check before
  sending and the Agy launch review line;
- the v0.1.64 items and older items still waiting for a hand test.

Agy's loading of Parley's instructions from its added folder is still
unverified, fresh or resumed.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
